items.title: Enteroendocrine cells hold stem and Paneth cells
items.text: 2013 cells (11% of epithelium) are called enteroendocrine, but only one sub-cluster (476) carries NEUROD1/SCGN/SCG5/FEV. The others are LGR5/ASCL2/SMOC2/EPHB3+ crypt-base cells and an ITLN2-high (92%), REP15/GUCA2A/KLK12+ Paneth-like group (572). Stem cells get 0 cells because the rule requires all four stem markers plus MKI67-; Paneth cells are missing from the list. Revise the list: Stem cells on LGR5|ASCL2|SMOC2, a Paneth cells type on ITLN2 with REP15, EEC on NEUROD1|SCGN|FEV|CHGB.

action.request: Draft a revised marker list (Stem cells on LGR5|ASCL2|SMOC2, Paneth cells on ITLN2 REP15, EEC on NEUROD1|SCGN|FEV|CHGB), check it and offer it with propose_marker_list

check.reason: Holds: EEC markers confined to one of three sub-clusters; the rest carry stem (LGR5/ASCL2) and Paneth (ITLN2) programmes expected in ileal crypts
check.evidence: type_structure(Enteroendocrine cells): /1 476 NEUROD1 50%, SCGN 64%, FEV 38%; /2 572 ITLN2 92%, GUCA2A, KLK12, REP15; /0 965 without own genes; review_markers EEC top genes ITLN2 59%, LGR5 53%, ASCL2 34% vs <=4% in siblings; Stem cells 0 cells

items.title: Cycling TAs is a crypt catch-all
items.text: 6171 cells (11% of all cells) are Cycling TAs, but MKI67/TOP2A are detected in only 34%. Sub-clusters: 1387 truly cycling (MKI67/TOP2A 69%), 1402 APOB/MGAM enterocyte-like, 746 goblet-like (REP15, RETNLB, SPINK4) and 560 LGR5/ASCL2 stem-like. Read the type as crypt epithelium, or require MKI67|TOP2A in the rule so the rest go to enterocytes, goblet and stem cells.

check.reason: Holds: proliferation is confined to one sub-cluster; early lineage genes in TAs explain part but not stem-like LGR5/ASCL2 cells or 34% MKI67 overall
check.evidence: type_structure(Cycling TAs): /4 1387 MKI67 69%; /6 1402 APOB 52%; /0 746 REP15/RETNLB/SPINK4; /3 560 LGR5/ASCL2 (clustering 4.1); review_markers MKI67 34%, PCLAF 7%, UBE2C 11%

items.title: NK cells are mostly gd T IELs
items.text: In the 314 'NK cells', CD3E is detected in 47% and TRDC in 56% (4% in other T/NK); 204 sit in the epithelium (median 7 um). These are gd T intraepithelial lymphocytes, while gd T cells hold only 11 cells. A further 110 deep cells carry fibroblast/muscle genes (SFRP2, GREM1, ACTG2). Revise: gd T cells on TRDC with CD3E, NK cells requiring CD3E- with KLRF1.

check.reason: Holds: CD3E as frequent as in T cells and TRDC 14x enriched rules out NK identity for the mucosal majority; spillover cannot explain TRDC
check.evidence: review_markers(NK cells): CD3E 47% vs 53% T siblings, TRDC 56% vs 4%; type_structure: /1 204 cells at 6.7 um depth in mucosa; gd T cells 11 cells

items.title: cDC2 are labelled Monocytes
items.text: Dendritic cells hold cDC1 (112, CLEC9A) and mregDC (92, CCR7) but no cDC2: CLEC10A is in 6% of DCs. The 'Monocytes' show CLEC10A 37%, ITGAX 78% and CD14 only 23%; their mucosal majority (443) has no monocyte programme, and a cycling IDO1+ group (155) is DC-like. Only the deep submucosal sub-cluster (234, FCN1 72%, CD14 53%) looks like monocytes. Add cDC2 (CLEC10A) under Dendritic cells.

check.reason: Holds: DC class lacks cDC2 entirely, and the Monocytes' CLEC10A/ITGAX profile without FCN1/CD14 in the mucosa fits cDC2; deep FCN1+ group stays monocytes
check.evidence: type_structure(Dendritic cells): /0 CLEC9A 44%, /1 CCR7 78%, no CLEC10A group (DC CLEC10A 6%); review_markers(Monocytes): CLEC10A 37%, ITGAX 78%, CD14 23% vs 40% siblings; type_structure(Monocytes): /1 deep FCN1 72% CD14 53%, /0 mucosal 443 without own genes

items.title: Mast cells in the muscularis are smooth muscle
items.text: 141 'Mast cells' sit deep in the muscularis propria (median 2.2 mm) with DES 92%, MYH11 96%, ACTG2 89%. They may be smooth muscle cells or KIT+ ICC (0 cells, the ICC rule excludes CPA3).

check.reason: Not refuted spillover: mast cells exist in the muscularis, and a mast cell inside dense muscle picks up SMC transcripts just as the 371 submucosal mast cells carry fibroblast genes (SFRP2/GREM1); tight clustering only reflects being in muscle. Without per-cell CPA3/ANO1 the relabel is not supported

items.title: Naive CD4 T cells are unreliable
items.text: Only 134 cells; CCR7 21%, SELL 10%, top genes LAMP3, CCL19, FSCN1 (mregDC genes), confusion 0.29 with effector/memory CD4. Merge into CD4 T cells or leave uninterpreted.

check.reason: Real but minor (134 cells) and already shown to the user as the kept marker check 'Naive CD4 T cells|CCR7+'; no separate action needed

items.title: Epithelial spillover into lamina propria
items.text: Epithelial markers are detected in 42.5% of non-epithelial cells within 10 um of the epithelium vs 6% beyond 60 um, and telocytes' top genes include FABP2, KRT8, CHP2. In DE or communication between lamina propria cells, treat epithelial genes there as spillover, not expression.

check.reason: Holds: a steep fall of epithelial markers with distance is the spillover signature, and it shows in telocytes' top genes; it changes how DE/communication in the lamina propria should be read
check.evidence: qc_overview: epithelial markers in non-epithelial cells 42.5% <10 um, 16.2% 10-30 um, 6.2% >60 um; review_markers(Telocytes) top genes FABP2 27% vs 1%, KRT8 39% vs 5%, CHP2 24% vs 1%

items.title: Registration holds
items.text: Max offset 2.1 um, residual 0.6 um, correlation 0.52 over 40 windows. No correction needed.

check.reason: Registration is fine (max 2.1 um, residual 0.6 um), so there is nothing for the user to do
